title: comdirect-fetch: Depot
description: Asset-Allokation und Einzelpositionsentwicklung – KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 2.

panels.title: Asset-Allokation (aktuellste Depotübersicht)
panels.description: Verteilung des Depotwerts auf Einzelpositionen zum letzten bekannten Stand. Gruppierung nach Anlageklasse ist ein möglicher späterer Ausbau (KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 2).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pp.display_name AS `Position`, pp.market_value AS `Wert`
FROM portfolio_positions pp
WHERE pp.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM portfolio_snapshots ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY pp.market_value DESC

SELECT pp.display_name AS `Position`, pp.isin AS `ISIN`, pp.quantity AS `Stück`, pp.market_value AS `Wert`, pp.acquisition_value AS `Anschaffungswert`, pp.profit_loss AS `Gewinn/Verlust`
FROM portfolio_positions pp
WHERE pp.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM portfolio_snapshots ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY pp.market_value DESC

panels.title: Einzelpositionsentwicklung – Kurswert je Position
panels.description: Marktwert je Position über die Zeit, aus portfolio_positions/portfolio_snapshots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, pp.display_name AS metric, pp.market_value AS value
FROM portfolio_positions pp
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON ps.id = pp.snapshot_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Einzelpositionsentwicklung – Gewinn/Verlust je Position
panels.description: Absoluter Gewinn/Verlust zum Anschaffungswert je Position über die Zeit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, pp.display_name AS metric, pp.profit_loss AS value
FROM portfolio_positions pp
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON ps.id = pp.snapshot_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time
